name: TailorColor
subtitle: Character fits and color picks
summary: Dress your character in what you wore and keep one outfit per day on a calendar.

hero.hook: Dress your character in what you wore, keep one outfit per day on a calendar, and get colors picked for your skin tone.
hero.shotAlt: The TailorColor Today tab. In front of the arch stage, the character wears a striped shirt, beige trousers and a crossbody bag. Below are a one-line reason for the colors and the Top, Bottom, Outer, Shoes and Extras tabs.

sections.title: Pick the clothes and dress your character
body: In My character, set the body, skin tone and hairstyle, then put on a top, bottoms, outerwear, shoes and extras. Each piece takes a kind, a color and a pattern, and the pieces you wore lately sit in the first row. There are 13 patterns, from checks and polka dots to leopard.
bullets: 3 body types, 6 skin tones, 20 hairstyles
16 tops, 15 bottoms, 21 outerwear pieces, 22 shoe styles
Hats, bags, scarves, neckties and more extras

visual.alt: Close-up of the Top tab. Sky Blue is the chosen color. Below are the Recently worn row and a grid of top kinds such as T-shirt, Shirt, Polo, Knit, Sweatshirt and Hoodie.
visual.caption: App screen, close-up

sections.title: Tap a piece and matching colors gather around it
body: Tap a piece on the character and colors that suit it appear in a ring around it. The one you tap goes on right there. Suggest colors reads your skin tone and personal color, and puts a one-line reason under every suggestion. Colors in Skipped colors stay out, and a piece you Keep stays put while the rest changes.
bullets: A color ring around the piece you tap
Suggest colors, with a reason for each pick
Skipped colors, Keep and Dress me randomly

visual.alt: The color ring opened on the shirt. Several color circles and a color wheel button surround the character, with a one-line reason for the colors below.
visual.caption: App screen, close-up

sections.title: One outfit a day, kept on a calendar
body: Tap Save today's fit and the outfit goes on the Record calendar under that date. Each date card lists what you wore piece by piece, with Similar fits in the same kinds and close colors, and Goes well with this fit. Use Pick a day to fill in past days or plan what to wear, and put pieces and whole fits back on from My closet.
bullets: A Record calendar with one outfit per day
Similar fits and Goes well with this fit
My closet and Show calendar events

sections.title: Stand it against a background and look closer
body: Tap anywhere on the character other than the clothes to see it full screen. The standard stage is the Arch, and under Background you can try the Home, the Cafe and a running path under a Han River bridge. The light follows sunrise and sunset where you are, through day, sunset and night. Saving with a background other than the Arch is part of TailorColor Pro.
bullets: Tap outside the clothes to look closer
Arch, Home, Cafe and Han River backgrounds
Day, sunset and night light

sections.title: 46 languages and dark mode
body: The app's screens come in 46 languages. It starts in your device language, and you can pick another under Language on the About screen. Appearance can be System, Light or Dark. There is no account or sign-in, and your outfits and records are saved on your iPhone.

items: Saved on your iPhone, no account

pro.title:
Removes the ads,
and adds backgrounds and Dress from a photo
items: No banners on Today and Record, and no ad before saving
Save outfits with the Home, Cafe and Han River backgrounds
Dress from a photo: the clothes in a photo go on your character
Try the backgrounds on before you buy

a: Open My character with the person button at the top of Today. Choose from three body types, six skin tones, twenty hairstyles and seven hair colors, and add glasses, a beard, hair accessories and blush.
Your personal color is set in My character too. Suggest colors looks at your skin tone and personal color when it picks.

Pick them from the Top, Bottom, Outer, Shoes and Extras tabs at the bottom of Today. There are 16 tops, 15 bottoms, 21 outerwear pieces and 22 shoe styles, and the extras include hats, bags, scarves and neckties.
Each tab has a color and a kind to choose, and 13 patterns such as checks, polka dots and leopard. The Recently worn row brings back pieces you put on before.

faq.q: The color ring and picking a color
a: Tap a piece on the character once and colors that suit it appear in a ring around it. Tap a color in the ring to change it right there, and tap outside the ring to close it.
At the start of each tab's color list are Pick any color and Pick from photo. Use Pick any color for an exact shade, or Pick from photo to take a color from a photo.
Tap Suggest colors and the character is dressed in colors that reflect your skin tone and personal color, with a one-line reason under the character.
Colors you put in Skipped colors are left out. A piece you Keep, with the button beside Kind, stays as it is while the rest changes. Dress me randomly puts on clothes and colors at random.

faq.q: Save today's fit and the Record tab
a: Tap Save today's fit and the outfit goes on the Record calendar. Each date holds one outfit, and saving again on a date that already has one asks before replacing it. Tap the date under the title on Today to open Pick a day, where you can fill in past days or plan what to wear.

Each date card lists what you wore, piece by piece. Bring to today puts that outfit on again for today, and Delete removes that day. Browse saved fits at the top of Record steps through your saved days, and Look closer shows one outfit full screen.
My closet gathers the pieces and whole fits you have worn, and choosing one puts it back on your character. Open it with the My closet button on Today or the hanger button at the top of Record.
Under each date card on Record are Similar fits, in the same kinds and close colors, and Goes well with this fit. Tap one of those to try it on.
Turn on Show calendar events in Record and each date card shows up to two event titles for that day. iOS asks for calendar access when you turn it on.
The app only reads events. It does not create or change them, and it does not keep the titles it reads.

Under Background on Today, choose the Arch, Home, Cafe or Han River. You furnish the Home yourself. The light changes through day, sunset and night: with location allowed it follows sunrise and sunset where you are, and without it the app goes by your device's time zone.

You can try on any background. Saving today's fit with a background other than the Arch asks for TailorColor Pro, and the same dialog can also save without the background. Days you already saved keep their backgrounds.

Take or choose a photo with the camera button at the top of Today, and the app reads the clothes in it to build an outfit for your character. The photo is read on your iPhone with Apple's Vision framework and is not kept.
Anyone can look over and fix what was read. Putting that outfit on your character is part of TailorColor Pro.
Google AdMob shows the ads. There is one banner at the bottom of Today and one at the bottom of Record, and a full-screen ad may appear just before saving when you tap Save today's fit.

The full-screen ad does not appear in the first 3 days after you first open the app, and after that it appears at most once every 24 hours. If the ad does not load, the save goes through anyway. Remove ads above a banner opens the TailorColor Pro purchase screen.

faq.q: TailorColor Pro and restoring the purchase
a: Tap the info button at the top of Today, then the TailorColor Pro row, to open the purchase screen. Pro adds three things: no ads, backgrounds and Dress from a photo. It supports Family Sharing. Everything else works without buying.
On a new device or after reinstalling, tap Restore Purchases on the About screen or the purchase screen. With the same Apple Account, you won't be charged again.

The app gets ads ready after the intro screens, and if you have not answered yet, iOS asks then whether TailorColor may track you. If you have TailorColor Pro, it does not ask. The app works the same either way, and you can change your answer in Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking.
Where ad consent is required, such as the European Economic Area, Google's consent form appears before the tracking prompt. There, change your choices under Privacy choices on the About screen.
If you see an ad that is inappropriate or does not fit the app's age rating, send the time you saw it and what it showed to kvndh36@naver.com. Once confirmed, it is blocked in AdMob.
TailorColor runs on iPhone only, with iOS 17 or later, and the screen stays in portrait.
The app's screens come in 46 languages. It starts in your device language, and you can pick another under Language on the About screen. Appearance, in the same place, can be System, Light or Dark.

faq.q: Account and where records are kept
a: There is no account or sign-in. Your clothes and records are saved in the app's storage on your iPhone and are removed when you delete the app.
Delete a saved day from its date card on Record, one day at a time.

privacy.title: TailorColor Privacy Policy
privacy.summary: The developer does not collect personal information. There is no sign-up, login or developer server, and your records are kept in the app's storage on your device. Ads come from Google AdMob, which processes device information such as the advertising identifier. Apple handles payment for TailorColor Pro.
intro: kvndh (the developer) handles the personal information of people who use the TailorColor app (the app) in line with the Personal Information Protection Act of Korea, and describes its practices below.

sections.title: Purposes of processing
paragraphs: The app has no sign-up or login, and the developer does not collect personal information from users.

The app shows banner ads at the bottom of the Today and Record tabs, and may show a full-screen ad just before it saves today's fit. Google's ad service AdMob selects and displays these ads, and uses device information to show ads and measure how they perform.

sections.title: Personal information processed
paragraphs: The developer collects no personal information. The app works with the data below, all of it kept in the app's storage on your device. The developer does not receive any of it.
Information that AdMob may collect when showing ads is listed in section 9.
bullets: Today's fit and the fit saved for each day (the character's look, the kind and color of each garment and accessory, the background, the date and when it was saved): used to show and wear them again from the Record tab
Colors and garments set aside as not worn, the wardrobe section, kept places, recent colors, and the day or night choice for backgrounds: used for suggestions and the editor
If you allow location, latitude and longitude rounded to one decimal place and when they were read: used to match the background's day and night

Language choice, whether Show calendar events is on, whether TailorColor Pro is purchased, whether the intro has been seen, when the app first ran and when the last full-screen ad appeared: used to run the app and to space out full-screen ads

sections.title: Retention period
paragraphs: The developer holds no personal information. Data in the app's storage is removed when you delete the app. A saved fit can be deleted day by day in the Record tab. The approximate location is read once and kept. While the background's day and night is set to Auto, the app reads it again when it comes to the front if the value is more than a week old, and replaces it. Photos and calendar event titles are not kept.
Information collected by AdMob is kept according to Google's Privacy Policy (policies.google.com/privacy).

sections.title: Disclosure to third parties
paragraphs: The developer does not provide users' personal information to third parties. When an ad is loaded and shown, however, the Google Mobile Ads SDK built into the app sends the information in section 9 directly to Google, as follows.
bullets: Recipient: Google LLC (United States), AdMob
Purpose: showing ads and measuring ad performance
Information: the device information and ad interaction records listed in section 9
When and how: sent over the internet when an ad is loaded and shown
Retention: as set out in Google's Privacy Policy

sections.title: Outsourcing
paragraphs: The developer does not outsource the processing of personal information. Apple processes payment for TailorColor Pro through the App Store, and payment information is governed by Apple's privacy policy. The developer does not receive your payment method or Apple Account details.

sections.title: Destruction of personal information
paragraphs: The developer holds no personal information, so there is nothing to destroy. To remove a saved fit, choose its day in the Record tab and tap Delete. Everything the app stores goes when you delete the app.

sections.title: Your rights and how to exercise them
paragraphs: The developer holds no personal information about you, so there is nothing to request access to, correct or delete. If you have questions, email us at the address below.

You can ask Google to give you access to, or delete, information collected by AdMob (policies.google.com/privacy). To refuse use of the advertising identifier, follow section 9. Payment information is held by Apple and is covered by Apple's privacy policy (apple.com/legal/privacy).

sections.title: Security measures
paragraphs: When you pick a color from a photo or use Dress from a photo, the app receives one photo: one you take with Take a photo, or one you choose in the iOS photo picker. iOS asks for camera permission the first time you tap Take a photo, and the app does not request permission to read your photo library. The photo is read on the device. Picking a color reads the color at the spot you tap, and Dress from a photo uses Apple's Vision framework to estimate the colors and kinds of the clothes. The photo is held in memory while that screen is open and is not saved to a file, and the developer does not receive it.

iOS asks for calendar permission only when you turn on Show calendar events in the Record tab. If you allow it, the date card in the Record tab shows up to two titles of that day's events. iOS presents this as full calendar access, but the app only reads the titles, start times, all-day flags and count of that day's events, and does not create or change events. The titles are not saved and are read again each time a card is shown, and the developer does not receive them.

iOS asks for location permission only when you pick a background or set the background's day and night to Auto, and does not ask when the app opens. The app requests approximate location with reduced accuracy, rounds the coordinates to one decimal place (about 11 km) and keeps them in the app's settings on the device. The value is used to work out sunrise and sunset there on the device, so the background can follow day, sunset and night, and it is not written into saved fits. If you don't allow it, the app estimates from the device's time zone. The app does not use this value for ads, and the developer does not receive your location.

sections.title: Automatic collection devices
paragraphs: The app does not use cookies or analytics tools. It includes the Google Mobile Ads SDK (AdMob) for advertising, which may collect the information below when it loads and shows ads.

The app gets ads ready after the intro screens are done. When it gets ads ready, iOS shows the App Tracking Transparency (ATT) prompt if you haven't answered it yet. The app works the same if you don't allow tracking. In that case AdMob does not receive the advertising identifier (IDFA), and ads still appear. You can change this in iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Tracking.

Banner ads appear at the bottom of the Today and Record tabs. The full-screen ad appears just before today's fit is saved. It does not appear in the first 3 days after the app first runs, and after that at most once every 24 hours. Saving goes through even if no ad loads.

In regions where ad consent is required, such as the European Economic Area, Google's consent form appears first. If the result is that ads can't be requested, the tracking prompt is not shown either. There, you can change your choices under Privacy choices on the About screen.

After you buy TailorColor Pro, banner and full-screen ads do not appear. From then on the app checks the purchase first when it opens, and once the purchase is confirmed it does not start AdMob, so neither the consent form nor the tracking prompt appears.
bullets: Device identifiers, and the advertising identifier (IDFA) if you allow tracking
Approximate location estimated from your IP address
Ad interaction records such as impressions and taps, and app usage records
App performance, crash, and diagnostic information

sections.title: Privacy officer
paragraphs: If you have questions about personal information, email us at the address below.

sections.title: Remedies
paragraphs: If you need advice about a privacy concern or help settling a dispute, you can contact the Korean bodies listed below. If you live outside Korea, you can also contact the supervisory authority where you live.
bullets: Personal Information Dispute Mediation Committee: 1833-6972 in Korea (www.kopico.go.kr)
Personal Information Infringement Report Center: 118 in Korea (privacy.kisa.or.kr)
Supreme Prosecutors' Office: 1301 in Korea (www.spo.go.kr)
National Police Agency: 182 in Korea (ecrm.police.go.kr)
European Union and EEA: your national data protection authority (edpb.europa.eu)
United Kingdom: Information Commissioner's Office (ico.org.uk)
United States: Federal Trade Commission (reportfraud.ftc.gov)
Elsewhere: your national privacy or consumer protection authority

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If this policy changes, the new text and its effective date are posted on this page.

2026-11-24: Rewritten in full for 1.0.0. It now covers Google AdMob ads and ad consent, the tracking prompt, payment for TailorColor Pro, how camera, calendar and location permissions are used, and the data kept on the device. The previous effective date was 2026-09-20.
